result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured, but a few minor visual issues were found: truncated restaurant name text, and edge-bleed carousel cards that could be improved.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, likely cut off as 'Trattoria Piccolo'.
issues.suggestion: Allow text to wrap to two lines or use ellipsis with a proper overflow handler so full names are readable.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right screen edge with no visible affordance that it is a horizontally scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator, partial peek spacing, or pagination dots to signal horizontal scrollability.
